objective: Lower margin error and win-probability log loss than the current NFL model (edgedesk_football_v1.0.0) out of sample, measured against the closing line as the baseline.
unit: every NFL game (regular season and postseason) with a final score and a consensus closing spread
metrics: share of games 3+ points from the close
ATS vs close at 1/2/3 pt gaps
CLV in points vs EdgeDesk's own opener capture (2026 only; no historical openers exist)

tuning.objective: margin MAE on the tune window
tuning.method: coordinate descent, two passes, over the grid below; garbage-time weight fixed at 0.25 (not tuned) and tested only as an ablation

incremental_value_bar: On the VALIDATION window only, each component is removed from the tuned model. A component stays active only if removing it raises validation margin MAE or validation log loss; otherwise it is marked inactive and the model is refitted without it. The holdout is not consulted.
decision_rule: v2 may replace v1 on the card only if, on the 2025 holdout, it has lower margin MAE AND lower log loss than v1 as trained (walk-forward) AND v1 as shipped, AND it is not worse on the full 2011-2025 backtest. Otherwise v1 stays and v2 remains EXPERIMENTAL. Beating the close is reported, not required.

forking_paths.disclosed_before_tuning: During development a single smoke test of the UNTUNED default configuration was scored on every window including the 2025 holdout (v2 MAE 10.18 vs v1-trained 10.17, log loss 0.644 vs 0.636). No setting was changed in response to the holdout; the grid above was fixed before it.
forking_paths.structural_choices: no intercept (neutral = 0); offense and defense separate coefficients; QB as its own rating parameter; travel rows centred on a typical trip so home field means home field with a typical trip; per-week snapshots (a Thursday game is not absorbed before that week's Sunday games).
